statement: The proposed readonly probe calls commonGroundRailPlan(), which can call railWaypoint() and mutate runtime.railTraversal. Snapshot inspection can therefore execute the controller instead of just observe published state, including during manual play.
classification: Source-level observer-effect concern under active integration, not a measured browser failure.
boundedAction: Return detached last-published rail state or explicitly unavailable plan; publish that state from ordinary controller execution only. Snapshot reads must not run the planner, advance/reset cursors, create story/route state or supply proof. Add meaningful repeated-read and returned-data mutation tests. Preserve normal gameplay behavior.
